description: This file defines a singleton object StringUtils that provides utility functions 'join' and 'split' for working with LinkedList objects, delegating to external utility classes JoinUtils and SplitUtils.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string utility functions such as join and split.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins the elements of a LinkedList into a String using an external utility.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList using an external utility.
